adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces `currentPage` and `totalPages` computed properties in `admin-group.js.es6` that divide by `this.get("limit")` without guarding against `limit === 0` (only `user_count == 0` is checked). The server endpoint `GroupsController#members` sets `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i`, so non-numeric/empty input can yield `0`, which is echoed back in `meta.limit` and assigned to the model in `Group#findMembers` (`limit: result.meta.limit`). That can lead to `offset/limit` or `user_count/limit` producing `Infinity`/`NaN` and breaking pagination/display logic.
